messages:
maria: Heads-up — I hit a perf regression on the AWQ INT8 weight-only path when prefetch is enabled and group_size is small (<=32). noticed on dedicated-prod-3 region during a canary run. attaching quick telemetry below. 

aj: ugh. can you paste p50/p95 and config? did kernel routing switch?

maria: p50 went from 22ms -> 34ms, p95 78ms -> 125ms for chat generate (seq_len=128, batch=1). config: AWQ int8, group_size=16, prefetch=true, kv_affinity=cpu-hot, kernel_policy=auto. no explicit kernel override.

kai: interesting. did the runtime pick the fp32 fallback kernel or a slow int8 kernel? do you have the kernel traces?

maria: yes — runtime chose kernel id 0x8f2 (int8_group_small) instead of earlier 0x7d1 (int8_group_large_prefetch). trace: 
```
KERNEL_DISPATCH: model:gptx, layer:12, kernel=0x8f2, group_size=16, seq=128, batch=1, latency=0.72ms
KERNEL_DISPATCH: model:gptx, layer:12, kernel=0x7d1, group_size=64, seq=128, batch=1, latency=0.18ms
KV_PREFETCH: enabled, mem_copy=sync, kv_cache_region=NUMA0
```

lee: that looks like an added copy sync on KV prefetch for small groups. we profiled earlier that sync kills the async pipeline. maybe heuristic flip on affinity.

perf-bot: telemetry snapshot: p50=34ms, p90=96ms, p95=125ms, throughput=210 tok/s, gpu_util=54%, memcpy_sync_rate=64%

aj: can you repro locally with microbench? maybe do `--batch=1 --seq=128 --group=16 --prefetch=on` and compare `--group=64`? also try `--kernel=prefer-7d1` to force the faster kernel (if available).

maria: running microbench now. quick note: with group=64 but prefetch still true, latency recovers to p50=20ms (slightly better than baseline). forcing kernel 0x7d1 with group=16 returns to p50=23ms (so kernel choice + prefetch interplay).

kai: sounds like our kernel selector underestimates overhead of prefetch+memcpy when group small — it probably estimates compute dominating. need to add a packing overhead model term: overhead ~ alpha*(1/group_size) + beta*memcpy_sync_ratio.

lee: agree. also check batching heuristics: at bursty small-batch traffic we might be hitting continuous-batching thresholds that increase latency when prefetch triggers. maybe prefetch should be gated by batch size or async copy availability.

aj: for immediate mitigation can we: 1) pin kernel to 0x7d1 for AWQ-int8 group<=32 when prefetch=true; 2) flip prefetch default to async for dedicated nodes; 3) add quick telemetry flag to measure memcpy_sync_rate per kernel.

maria: implementing a quick router tweak now (will roll to canary). also adding `-runtime.telemetry.kv_copy_mode` metric to logs.

perf-bot: canary rollout started on dedicated-prod-3 at 1932102520 — routing override: prefer kernel 0x7d1 for awq-int8/group<=32. monitoring p50/p95.

maria: early canary numbers look promising: p50=21ms, p95=82ms after override. will leave canary for 30m then decide. thanks all. :thumbsup:

aj: follow-up: file an issue to extend kernel selector cost model with prefetch/memcopy terms + expose group_size effect in console. tag with perf/regression and assign to eng-ml.

kai: noted. I'll write the cost-model PR template and add a small synthetic benchmark suite for prefetch vs group_size.

maria: adding logs & a short repro in the issue. also saving the trace snippet to s3://redwood-perf/1932102468/ for postmortem.

lee: nice — once fixed let's also add an Optimize suggestion: "avoid prefetch for small-group AWQ" so customers get a config hint.

perf-bot: canary completed at 1932102580 — p50 stable at 21ms, p95 84ms, rollback not required.
